title: Bookkeeper
description:
Bookkeeper (Fixed-Term Contract with Permanent Opportunity)

Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 per annum (depending on experience)
Contract: Initial 3-Month Fixed-Term Contract with potential to become permanent
Hours: Full-time preferred. Part-time (minimum 30 hours per week) will be considered for the right candidate.

About the Role

We are currently seeking an organised and detail-oriented Bookkeeper to join our finance team on an initial three-month fixed-term contract. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional looking to join a supportive and growing business, with a strong possibility of the role becoming permanent.
Working as part of a small finance team, you will play a key role in supporting the Senior Management Team through the accurate and timely processing of financial transactions, maintaining sales and purchase ledgers, bank reconciliations, credit control activities, and providing wider administrative support.

Key Responsibilities
- Maintain accurate Purchase and Sales Ledger records.
- Process purchase invoices and match them to purchase orders.
- Reconcile customer accounts and sales ledger transactions.
- Perform multi-currency bank reconciliations and ensure correct allocation of transactions.
- Support the credit control function, helping to ensure timely customer payments.
- Respond to customer queries regarding invoices and payments.
- Assist with the cleansing and maintenance of supplier and customer records.
- Provide general administrative support to Senior Management and the wider business.
- Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the finance function.
- Undertake any other reasonable duties as required by management.

Essential Criteria
- Minimum of 5 GCSEs (or equivalent), including Maths and English.
- At least 2 years' experience in a bookkeeping, accounts, finance, or administration role.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
- Excellent numerical, analytical, and data-entry skills with a high level of accuracy.
- Ability to manage workloads effectively and meet deadlines.
- Strong organisational and multitasking skills.
- Excellent communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Experience using finance, accounting, or ERP systems.

Desirable Criteria
- Accounting Technician qualification, or currently studying towards an accounting qualification.
- Experience using Sage, particularly Sage Intacct.
- Experience using Opera accounting software.
- Previous experience working within a busy finance department.

Skills & Attributes

The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Attention to Detail
A commitment to accuracy and maintaining high-quality financial records.
Communication Skills
The ability to build positive relationships with customers, suppliers, and colleagues.
Organisation & Time Management
The ability to prioritise workloads effectively while meeting deadlines.
Team Player
A flexible and collaborative approach, with a willingness to support colleagues and contribute to the success of the wider business.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary- depending on experience.
- Opportunity to secure a permanent position following the initial contract period.
- Flexible working options, with part-time hours considered.
- Supportive and friendly team environment.
- Career development opportunities within a growing business.

If you are an experienced Bookkeeper looking for your next opportunity and want to join a company where your contribution will be valued, we'd love to hear from you.

Brook Street NMR is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Main purpose of job Finance Assistant

To be responsible to the Finance Officer (Cashier Service) for the delivery of a quality cashier service.

To assist with managing the councils cash resources and bank accounts in line with the needs of user departments.

Summary of responsibilities and personal duties Finance Assistant
- To assist the Finance Officer (Cashier Service) with tasks relating to the management of the cashier service including its bank accounts.
- To assist the Finance Officer (Cashier Service) with the updating of appropriate policies, regulations and legislation.
- To provide advice and guidance to user departments and suppliers with regard to the cashier service.
- To liaise with the appropriate bank(s) under the direction of the Finance Officer (Cashier Service) with regard to banking facilities and queries.
- To administer payroll deductions and ensure timely payment to recipients, for example, Inland Revenue, NILGOSC, Trade Unions and other relevant bodies.
- To process payments in relation to Accounts Payable and Payroll transactions.
- To assist with the administration and preparation of statistical reports relating to the Cashiers Imprest Bank Account, Euro Bank Account and other bank accounts relevant to the cashier service.
- To assist the Finance Officer (Cashier Service) with maintaining, updating and monitoring a list of the councils bank accounts.
- To assist with the Bankers Automatic Clearing Systems (BACS) on behalf of the council by liaising with the sponsor, BACS and Digital Services in respect of new developments.
- To assist with the implementation of best value and quality improvements.
- To make recommendations to the Finance Officer (Cashier Service) with regard to developing and improving the service.
- To participate in all induction and in-service training provided by Belfast City Council and in the induction and support of all newly appointed staff and other human resource management policies and procedures, as appropriate, including, absence management, disciplinary and grievance procedure.
- To act in accordance with the council and departmental policies and procedures including customer care, equal opportunities, health and safety, safeguarding and any pertinent legislation.
- To undertake the duties in such a way as to enhance and protect the reputation and public profile of the council.
- To undertake such other relevant duties as may from time to time be required.

Experience Finance Assistant

Applicants must, as at the closing date for receipt of application forms, be able to demonstrate, by providing personal and specific examples on the application form, at least one years relevant experience in each of the following areas:
- working in a financial environment and dealing with reconciliation of payments in 1 a large public or private sector organisation;
- using Microsoft Office IT applications and financial packages used for the processing of BACS payments; and
- working in a busy office environment as part of a team, using prioritisation skills to adhere to strict deadlines.

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
